text: I keep missing home maintenance chores. In /home/santosh/codeaf-pr-live-review-20260927/pr1562-acceptance/project, build a small Python command-line helper that reads maintenance.csv and shows unfinished chores due by a date I give it. The project notes are in docs/design/plandb-cli/DESIGN.md. Track your implementation in the project-local PlanDB file /home/santosh/codeaf-pr-live-review-20260927/pr1562-acceptance/project/.plandb.db (always pass --db explicitly). Include tests and a short README, and try it on the sample data so I can see it work.

Actually, a chore I have started is still unfinished. Please make the next change as a task in the same project: include in-progress chores as well as open ones, add a JSON output option so I can use this from another script, and add a sample in-progress chore due September 25. Keep the normal text output easy to read. Run the tests and show me the JSON for October 1.

/task In /home/santosh/codeaf-pr-live-review-20260927/pr1562-acceptance/project, add a way to mark a chore done by exact title from the command line, updating maintenance.csv safely. I want to use this every week, so reject missing or ambiguous titles without changing the CSV. Keep the existing due-date and JSON views working. Update the README and tests, then run the tests.

The app says the task branch could not merge cleanly. Please resolve that in the maintenance project, preserving the JSON feature and the sample data we just added. Keep the local PlanDB database out of Git. Then actually use the finished helper to mark Clean dryer vent done and show me the remaining chores due October 1 in both text and JSON. I want the working project ready to use, not just a retained branch.

I will usually run this from my home directory, not from inside the project. Please give me one copy-paste command that shows the remaining chores due October 1 as JSON from home, and actually try it so I know the paths work. No scheduling or further changes needed.
